name: variant-counter
description: variant-counter: /variants [idea], plus a toast when a new verdict passes 20 variants. /variants lists the ideas in ~/Trading/_ledger/experiments.jsonl by distinct variants tried, flagging those over variant_limit (policy.json, default 20) and whether any run has an RC/SPA p <= rc_alpha; /variants <idea> lists that idea's variants. The toast fires once per verdict (idea, variant, written_at) whose idea count, from the ledger plus its own variant, is over the limit, whether or not the variant_counter rule is on.
